question: Which standing-team policies should the teams apply?
big_picture: Eight policies set how far the standing-teams programme can go. Your answer lets the teams apply the selected changes; if you do not answer, every safe default stays in force and the programme continues. You can choose all eight or select the six reversible policies and decide the open-ended access grant and permanent deletion separately.
reason: Taking all eight sets useful limits, reduces repeat permission requests and removes unnecessary code.

options.label: Apply the policies selected in the multi-select
